title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Floyd L Maines Veterans Memorial Arena, Binghamton | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Floyd L Maines Veterans Memorial Arena in Binghamton, New York, USA, on 18 September 2018.

It was the 36th show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Graham Gouldman: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
